title: Parallax words
description: Three rows of very large outlined words drift sideways at different speeds (GSAP timeline) behind one clear sentence in the middle. On a web page the scroll moves the rows.

props.text: required, one sentence, up to 9 words
props.words: 3 single words for the rows behind (default: the three longest words of the sentence, never other words)

example.text: Motion graphics on video, slides and websites.
